I added and exported `formatInvoiceNumber(year, sequence)` in `lib/invoices.js`. It returns numbers like `INV-2026-000123`, with the year as four digits and the sequence zero-padded to six. The padding is there because the accounting export sorts invoice numbers as text.

The 8 existing tests still pass. I also called the function once with `(2026, 123)` and `(2026, 1)`, which gave `INV-2026-000123` and `INV-2026-000001`. I didn't add a test for it, and nothing calls it yet. `createInvoice` still uses the old `inv_N` ids.

The function doesn't validate its inputs. A sequence above 999999 would produce a longer number and break the text sort. Say if you want it to throw in that case.
